card.title: BLOHM & VOSS BV 138
card.text: Draw a card when the enemy triggers your countermeasure.
card.flavorText: The Blohm & Voss BV 138 Seedrache (e. Sea Dragon) was a German flying boat that was used by the Luftwaffe during WWII as a naval patrol and reconnaissance aircraft. The aircraft was produced in 1938-1943 and the standard variants had an armament of two 20 mm MG 151/20 cannons, up to three 7.92 mm MG 15 machine guns and finally a 13 mm MG 131 machine gun. Some had specialized roles such as a minesweeping variant that carried a magnetic field generating degaussing equipment and an anti-shipping variant that was fitted with a maritime search radar. A total of 297 aircraft were built, including a few variants.
